title: Case: Courier misses a booked return collection
context: A scheduled return collection was missed. The collection team has the approved return reference and needs a replacement window within the customer’s availability.
initial_request: Nobody collected my return. I can be home on 2027-03-06, 10:00–14:00. Please book another collection within that window.

events.body: Collection for RT-6367 was missed on the previous route day; parcel remains with customer. Approved return and packaging requirements are unchanged. Rebooking is at no charge.
Nobody collected my return. I can be home on 2027-03-06, 10:00–14:00. Please book another collection within that window.
Nobody collected my return. I can be home on 2027-03-06, 10:00–14:00. Please book another collection within that window.

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the collection team to rebook within the customer's confirmed availability.

must_not: Collection receipt establishes carrier custody only, not merchant receipt or refund.
Treats the repeated copy of the request as a second, separate request (for example by sending two requests to the same team)
expected.reference_message: Please rebook RT-6367 within 2027-03-06, 10:00–14:00 UTC and provide the actual collection receipt after pickup, not just a booking status.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-033: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. The escalation message arrives twice; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
